2607.07077.title: Navigating Hierarchy: Hyperbolic Learning on Brain Graphs for Disorder Diagnosis
2607.07077.paper_summary: Functional brain networks exhibit a hierarchical organization across ROI, community, and whole-brain levels, supporting local processing, inter-community coordination, and global integration. Recent studies have demonstrated that brain community-aware modeling is beneficial for both diagnosis and biomarker identification of brain networks. However, existing brain graph modeling methods often struggle to model ROI-community interactions, thereby failing to fully exploit the hierarchy across ROI, community, and whole-brain network levels. To address this issue, inspired by deep hyperbolic learning in modeling hierarchical structures, we propose a novel framework, termed Hyperbolic Learning on Brain Graphs (HLBG), for brain network analysis. The core idea of HLBG is to exploit the inherent hierarchical geometry of hyperbolic space to model the hierarchical relationships among ROIs, functional communities, and the whole-brain network, thereby learning hierarchy-aware and highly discriminative representations for brain network data. Specifically, HLBG first projects representations from ROIs, communities, and the whole-brain network into Lorentzian hyperbolic space. Then, the multi-level hierarchy is imposed via two geometric entailment constraints. In addition, we introduce a new Graph-aware Mamba (GaMamba) model, which incorporates topology-derived structural prompts into Mamba to capture long-range dependencies while preserving graph topological information. Experiments on ABIDE-I and REST-MDD demonstrate that HLBG outperforms state-of-the-art methods and identifies disorder-relevant functional biomarkers.
2607.07077.paper_summary_zh: 功能性腦網絡在ROI、社群和全腦層面上展現出層級組織，支持局部處理、社群間協調和全球整合。最近的研究表明，腦社群感知建模對於腦網絡的診斷和生物標記識別是有益的。然而，現有的腦圖建模方法往往難以建模ROI-社群互動，從而未能充分利用ROI、社群和全腦網絡層面之間的層級結構。為了解決這個問題，我們受到深層超曲率學習在建模層級結構中的啟發，提出了一個新框架，稱為腦圖上的超曲率學習（HLBG），用於腦網絡分析。HLBG的核心思想是利用超曲率空間的固有層級幾何來建模ROI、功能社群和全腦網絡之間的層級關係，從而學習具有層級感知和高度區分性的腦網絡數據表示。具體而言，HLBG首先將來自ROI、社群和全腦網絡的表示投影到洛倫茲超曲率空間中。然後，通過兩個幾何推導約束施加多層級層級結構。此外，我們引入了一種新的圖感知Mamba（GaMamba）模型，該模型將拓撲衍生的結構提示納入Mamba，以捕捉長距離依賴性，同時保留圖的拓撲信息。在ABIDE-I和REST-MDD上的實驗表明，HLBG的表現超過了最先進的方法，並識別出與疾病相關的功能生物標記。
